Our clinic

A concierge clinic, not a conveyor belt

Opened in Lincoln Park in June 2023, Better Med Spa & Wellness has treated more than 10,000 patients. That scale comes with a small-clinic promise: time to listen, a plan explained in plain language, and follow-up that does not end at the door.

Medical Director Dr. Brett Brechner, DO leads a physician-led team. K-Beauty influences how we think about skin — barrier health, hydration and consistency — while medical-grade treatments handle what skincare alone cannot.

Good to know

Questions, answered before you book

What makes the care K-Beauty-led?

We lead with hydration, barrier health and glow — the Korean skincare philosophy — and add medical-grade treatments only where they genuinely help.

Do I need a consultation first?

For injectables and personalised plans, yes. It is how we confirm pricing, units and suitability before any treatment.

Where are you, and when are you open?
